name: local/create-profile
description: Creates sensei profiles that define agent roles with scoped permissions and constraints. Investigates the repo for existing profiles and conventions, writes a focused profile markdown file, and validates scope boundaries. Use when the user wants to create an agent profile, define a specialized role, scope an agent to specific files or domains, set up a new team member persona, restrict what an agent can touch, or wants consistent behavior from a domain-specific agent.
